title: Implement loopback default and fail-closed protected LAN controls

gates.name: LAN and CORS security tests
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/security backend/tests/integration -k 'lan or cors or loopback'

verify: Run required gates and attach output under .tasks/TASK-014/: LAN and CORS security tests: pytest backend/tests/security backend/tests/integration -k 'lan or cors or loopback'; memory bank lint: node scripts/mb-lint.mjs

Confirm task verification targets are satisfied: test:privacy.local-only-loopback-lan-controls; CORS/origin misconfiguration fails closed; LAN mode does not weaken ActorContext or PlantAccessGrant authorization
Validate listed constraints and invariants against the implementation and record any exception as a blocker before closure.
Run /verify and /red-verify before closure, record VERDICT: PASS and SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, and include HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done plus ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present as standalone evidence.

Prove loopback and LAN state-changing browser requests are write-protected beyond CORS alone: cross-site simple requests from an untrusted origin cannot mutate state, and same-origin/CSRF-equivalent protection fails closed.
evidence_required: Tests proving default backend binding/config is loopback/private
Tests proving LAN mode is explicitly enabled and fails closed with missing, malformed, or broad CORS/origin config
Tests proving LAN mode requires auth/session and preserves ActorContext/PlantAccessGrant authorization
T3 human checkpoint and rollback/recovery note before closure
Browser write-protection tests for loopback/LAN state-changing requests, including cross-site simple request denial and same-origin/CSRF-equivalent fail-closed behavior
constraints: Backend binds to loopback by default
LAN mode must be explicitly enabled by local operator configuration or UI flow
LAN mode requires local authentication/session, backend authorization, token/session protection, and explicit CORS/origin allowlist
State-changing loopback/LAN browser requests require same-origin/CSRF-equivalent write protection and cannot rely on CORS alone
invariants: LAN mode must not weaken local authorization
Internal traces, secrets, raw provider output, and auth material must not appear in responses
verification_targets: LAN mode does not weaken ActorContext or PlantAccessGrant authorization
Cross-site simple browser requests cannot perform state-changing loopback/LAN writes
